conditions: The rules target the same CDS entity, include both explicit combination modes, and consist only of ordinary conditional rules without REDEFINITION.
limitations: Full-access rules and redefinition have separate effects. This claim concerns rule composition across access rules in Release 754. Operator priority inside an individual condition is separate.

triggers: SAP correction, edition remapping, source byte drift, or contrary primary evidence.

statement: For ordinary conditional access rules on the same CDS entity with both explicit combination modes present, SAP AS ABAP 7.54 combines the OR-mode conditions as one disjunction and conjoins that result with every AND-mode condition.
